Interface StateVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
ViewUpdater
public interface StateVisitor
Defines the visitor interface for handling state updates received from the server. The methods implemented in ViewUpdater contain the specific logic for processing each concrete implementation of the StateDTO.
